Community Projects

​

​The Community program is designed to provide funds for community development projects that address human service needs, such as senior centers, crisis centers, fire stations and facilities that provide services to low-income persons. As part of the Commonwealth's allocation from the CDBG program, these projects have been allocated with the maximum amount of $8​50,000 of CDBG funding per community.

Who can Apply: All cities and counties are eligible to apply for the funds with the exception of entitlement communities.

Applications Accepted: April 1, 2026 - September 1, 2026​​.

For more information see the Community Development Block Grant Program Guidelines or contact the the office.
